environment.location: Oxford Mine Adits - Lower Collapse Zone
environment.description: A damp, rusted out mine shaft. The ceiling timbers are splintered and venting superheated geothermal steam from fractured adit ribs. Falling shale and rock debris litter the floor.

entities.name: Silt-Marrow the Unhewn
entities.intent: Bring the ceiling down on all biological motion to achieve tectonic stillness.
